shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies, a PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment, enemy psycaster tiers, two pilgrimage quest chains, an in-game synergy balance editor (dev tool), a full XML trigger API for awakening (7 surfaces), and a mod-facing TieringOverrideDef to hand the whole ladder to another mod.
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (declares missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads -> spams VDE_AwakenedDryad PawnKindDef + dryad texture errors; re-add only if the Dryads mod gets installed), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum (missing dep), gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE (not a psycast addon). Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)"; incidents pin as "Actions\Do incident\PS_Awakening" / "Actions\Do incident\PS_AwakeningSurgeIncident". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors (e.g. PathBG_Archon.dds); stale palette pins from other sessions. cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* etc. are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml) — in-game tuning edits live there, but the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## No trait system
The enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier, brain-seated). There is NO enlightenment trait - SetTier/TierOf are 100% hediff-based; Traits.xml is empty.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400 (slider 30-500), overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Patch_LevelCap.EffectiveMax = BaseMax() (no tier). levelCapPerTier removed. Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier (hostile psycaster -> chance enemyTierFreq of a tier upgrade), then GatePsylink (when `gateUntieredPsylinks`, default ON): skip Awakened+/PS_AncientPsycasters; eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05) to spawn as fresh Awakened (EnsurePsycaster + ApplyTier 70/22/8); otherwise generated psylinks are stripped. Tunable; 0% = none. `noAwakenedStartingPawns` (default ON) — pawns generated with PawnGenerationContext.PlayerStarter (new-game character creation) are exempt from the random Awakened+ roll, so starting colonists always begin mundane (any generated psylink still gets stripped by the gate); settings row indented under the spawn-chance slider, only shown while the gate is on. GrantPaths/GrantAscension are internal (reused by AwakeningTrigger.SilentGrant). All gates also respect TieringControl (EnemyTiersDisabled / PsylinkGateDisabled / RandomAwakenedSpawnsDisabled).

## XML Awakening Trigger API (AwakeningTrigger.cs + AwakeningSurfaces.cs + Defs/AwakeningTriggers.xml)
One shared `AwakeningTriggerExtension` DefModExtension vocabulary (tier/minAge/silent/letterLabel+Text with {PAWN}; one-shot: chance; persistent: chancePerDay, onlyWhileMeditating, scaleWithCertainty; surge: breakthroughMult; incident: incidentTarget=meditator|random) + one funnel `AwakeningTrigger.Fire(pawn, ext, source)` (public overload Fire(pawn, tier, silent) for C# mods). Eligibility: humanlike, alive, minAge (13), TierOf < tier — safe to re-apply. Player-faction pawns: med.awakened=true BEFORE EnsurePsycaster (blocks external-psylink double-fire), letter, OpenPick(tier) (card pick applies tier on embrace). Everyone else / silent: SilentGrant = EnsurePsycaster + SetTier (spec points only for player pawns) + ChangeLevel(+3/+4/+5 per tier gained = 3/7/12 cumulative parity with enemy tiers) + Patch_EnemyTiers.GrantPaths(delta) + full psyfocus + GrantAscension for non-player tier3+ when enemyAscension; letter for player pawns.
**7 surfaces:** (1) HediffComp_TriggerAwakening — fires once on CompPostPostAdd rolling `chance`, self-removes via CompShouldRemove (fired flag scribed); shipped hediffs PS_AwakeningTrigger / TierII / TierIII (parent PS_AwakeningTriggerBase; children override modExtensions with Inherit=False). Works from any hediff-granting surface (ingestion outcome, ability GiveHediff, surgery, ritual effecter, gene, scenario). (2) CompUseEffect_TriggerAwakening (CompProperties_UseEffectTriggerAwakening) — usable artifacts; CanBeUsedBy refuses ineligible pawns; chance-miss shows a "psychic stirring" message. (3) IncidentWorker_TriggerAwakening + shipped PS_Awakening (baseChance 0, Map_PlayerHome) — targets deepest awakenMeditationTicks ("meditator") or "random". (4) GameCondition_AwakeningSurge + shipped PS_AwakeningSurge def (mult ×3, 25%/day meditators-only, canBePermanent) + inert wrapper incident PS_AwakeningSurgeIncident (IncidentWorker_MakeGameCondition, 1.5~3 days, baseChance 0); SurgeMult(map) multiplies BOTH RollHourly chances (inside the 0.6 caps) via GetAllGameConditionsAffectingMap (world conditions included, stacks multiplicatively). (5) ThoughtDef carrying the extension — hourly scan rolls PerHour(chancePerDay) for pawns holding the thought (GetAllMoodThoughts = memories + situational). (6) PreceptDef carrying the extension — believers roll; optional certainty scaling. (7) QuestNode_TriggerAwakening / QuestPart_TriggerAwakening — signal-driven; pawns from slate refs (pawn/pawns) or signal SUBJECT arg; tier/silent/chance SlateRefs; full ExposeData + ReplacePawnReferences.
**Hooks:** MeditationSystem.Tick calls AwakeningTrigger.HourlyScan(gc) every 2500 ticks (independent of enlightenmentEnabled); scan covers map FreeColonistsSpawned + caravan/transporter free colonists (thought/precept only; surge is map-bound). Def caches (thoughtTriggers/preceptTriggers) built lazily on first scan — zero cost when unused. IsActivelyMeditating is internal now.
**Docs:** wiki page docs/wiki/xml-triggers.html (Reference section) with the vocabulary table + copy-paste examples for all 7 surfaces + TieringOverrideDef.

## TieringOverrideDef — mod-facing ladder handoff (TieringOverride.cs)
Custom def type `<PsycastSynergies.TieringOverrideDef>`: a mod author ships one def to take over tier progression. **Disable flags** (umbrella `disableBuiltInTiering` = all): disableMeditationAwakening (RollHourly non-psycaster branch skipped; psycaster level breakthroughs untouched), disableTranscendence (tier-4+ climb), disablePilgrimages (both QuestNode roots' TestRunInt return false; dev "run quest script" still bypasses intentionally), disableExternalPsylinkAwakening (Patch_ExternalPsylinkAwaken), disableEnemyTiers, disableRandomAwakenedSpawns, disablePsylinkGate. Overrides beat player settings; affected settings rows show an amber ModOverrideNote naming the owning mod. **Reskin:** tierNames (tiers 1..N; consulted by EnlightenmentTier.Name → flows to letters/health tab/card picks/spec UI; Window_Specializations.TierWord now routes through Name(clamp 0..3)), tierNameBeyondFormat ({TIER}/{ROMAN} tokens; unset keeps "Transcendent {ROMAN}"), tierSpecPoints (on-reach rewards, past-list = last entry; consulted by GrantTierPoints, beats tier2/tier3SpecPoints settings). **TieringControl** static aggregator: lazy Build() over all defs — disables OR-merge, first-wins for reskin fields (warning names losers), OwnerLabel = mod names, startup log line summarizing the handoff. Trigger API (Fire etc.) deliberately ignores all disables — it IS the replacement progression. Awakening-meditation ticks still accrue while disabled (keeps incident "meditator" targeting meaningful). Wiki: section 8 on xml-triggers.html. Tested in-game (run #21) via a temp full-handoff def (Initiate/Adept/Master reskin) — def deleted after; only VPE .dds noise observed.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts from psycaster stats at startup when JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling is active.

## Awakening cards: manual flips, configurable deal, Esc-safe (2026-07-10)
`cardRevealAll` mode NO LONGER auto-flips the rest of the deck: after the first (committal-by-default) turn, remaining cards stay face-down and are turned BY HAND — click a centered face-down card to flip it (side cards scroll toward center first); any revealed card can be clicked to re-pick, and the centered-revealed card is the live selection (carousel-follow guarded by flipT>=0.999 so face-down cards never steal the pick). New setting `cardPickCount` (int, slider 0-8, default 0): 0 = auto (classic 3 cards; 5 at a Tier II pilgrimage), 1-8 = fixed deal for EVERY tier-up; consumed in MeditationSystem.ShowNextPick; BuildPool naturally caps at not-yet-unlocked paths. Settings row in Meditation tab -> "Awakening and cards".
**Esc soft-lock fix:** Window_Awakening tracks `resolved` (set by Confirm/ForgoForPoints/DeferReroll). PostClose without a decision (Esc/cancel) requeues `med.pendingPick = tier` (scribed — survives save/load; the in-memory pickQueue does NOT) + a caution message. Comas NO LONGER forfeit pendingPick (old med.pendingPick=0 line removed — losing a tier-up to a coma was itself a soft lock). New `Alert_PendingCardPick` (auto-registered Alert subclass, AlertPriority.High): culprits = map+caravan free colonists with pendingPick>0; label counts them; CLICKING the alert consumes pendingPick and re-opens the pick immediately (falls back to jump-to-culprit when a pick window is already open). Meditation hourly roll remains the other re-open path.

## In-game synergy balance editor (replaces the HTML/JSON export flow)
**Access:** psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)" row above the reset buttons (Patch_PsycastTabRespec). Window_BalanceEditor captures the tab's pawn + Psycasts hediff + CompAbilities at open.
**UI (Modern-suite / Cube style, ~1560×800, sentence-case):** THREE panes. (1) Rail: every path, one tree at a time, edit badges. (2) Cards: dropdown chips for primary "Skill effect" (stat + ×0.25-×3 strength), "Gains power from" rows (source + stat + strength + remove/add, cap 6), "Empowers" rows (target + stat + strength + remove/add — edits the TARGET's sources). Override chips get accent borders; +%/lvl shown per row; header = edit count + Reset path/all. Selecting a skill (card click OR preview node click) also JUMPS the card list so that skill's card is at top (scrollToSel). (3) Preview (460px): real path art via PathArt.Get (retexture-aware, safe .dds; aspect drives height 320-720; TileTint fallback), all nodes unlocked-look via PsycastsUIUtility + level pips; selected node accent box + "Editing · <stat>", sources emerald boxes/tags/lines, empower targets gold (tab hover-pulse colors); node clicks focus without consuming. Below: "Live values — <pawn>" (Scalables, primary gilded) + "Scaling — edits apply live" (◂/▸ rates). FlatScroll everywhere (0xBE01-03).
**Layering (PsycastInfo):** PlayerTuning (settings overlay) > ManualBalance.json (baked) > frozenSyn > computed. Base* getters expose the pre-player baseline; only diffs are stored (re-picking the default clears). Mutations clear caches; WriteSettings on close/reset.
**Storage:** tunePrimStat/tunePrimStr (defName), tuneEdgeStat/tuneEdgeStr ("src|tgt"), tuneSrcs (defName -> "A;B;C").
**Bake support (mod settings, Specializations tab -> "Balance edits"):** "Bake N edit(s) into mod defaults" -> ManualBalance.BakePlayerTuning: merges the player overlay over the currently-baked records (player wins; edge keys pipe->arrow converted), serializes ALL records (prim/edge with independent stat/str fields; srcs as semicolon lists) to <modRoot>/ManualBalance.json, reloads, clears the overlay (baked = new baseline), WriteSettings. Plus "Discard my balance edits". Both confirm-gated; works from main menu. Workshop-update caveat noted in the confirm text.
**Removed:** BalanceEditor.cs (HTML/JSON export).

## Psycast tab tool block + focus/path pickers (2026-07-10, replaces the pawn gizmos)
The per-pawn "Default focus" and "Pilgrim's Path" GIZMOS are REMOVED (Patch_PawnDefaultFocusGizmo now only yields the "Stop meditating" button; the building attunement gizmo on meditation foci is untouched). Their function moved into the psycast tab's bottom tool block (Patch_PsycastTabRespec), centered on the left pawn-info card: rows bottom-up = [Reset skills | Reset path] (formerly "Respec ..."), "Pilgrim's path: <Unbound/Trial of the Altar/Way of the Anima> ▾" dropdown (player faction + tier>=1; FloatMenu with the 3 Pilgrim icons; incapable-of-violence pawns get the reject message), optional "Default focus ▾" fallback row, dev "Balance editor" row on top.
**Card-width anchoring (IMPORTANT):** Modern UI's left card is a FIXED 340px at x=14 — anchoring off size.x*0.3 drifts at narrow tab widths. `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardWidth(tabWidth)` = 340 when Wired else min(size.x*0.3, 340); used by BOTH the footer block AND Patch_SpecButtonInTab. The ★ spec button + tier numeral badge are right-aligned FLUSH to the card's own edge (3px inside the 2px border, i.e. right edge at x=14+340-3), NOT the 14px content edge — user explicitly wanted edge-flush (verified iteratively via screenshots).
**Focus picking via Modern Psycasts UI:** that mod ships `ModernPsycastsUI.PawnFocusHooks` (public static Active/Get/Set delegates, null by default). Psycasts² wires them by reflection at startup (ModernUIBridge.TryWire from HarmonyInit; no hard dependency either way) so the focus-type tiles in the tab's left panel become real buttons: click = set pawn default focus (accent border + silent message), click the selected tile = clear to "any"; the unlock "+" keeps click priority. When the hooks aren't wired, the tab shows the "Default focus ▾" dropdown fallback row instead.
**Modern Psycasts UI also fixed:** locked path tiles now say just "Locked" (no dangling colon/lockedReason — requirements live in the tooltip). Both mods rebuilt.

## Text conventions (2026-07-10 pass)
"Respec" is BANNED in user-facing text — it's "Reset" everywhere (Reset skills / Reset path / Reset all / Reset specializations / "X reset their psycasts"); code identifiers (Patch_PsycastTabRespec, RespecAll, RespecTex, UI/Specs/respec.png) intentionally keep the old name. "&" is BANNED in user-facing text — always the full word "and" (settings headers, spec descs, tooltips, HTML reports; the HTML Esc() functions still escape & to & — that's markup safety, leave them). Full sentence-case sweep done over settings headers ("Skill leveling", "What scales", "Cost and caps", "Specialization points", "Path access", "Synergy graph", "Balance edits", "A flow of ancient knowledge", "Over-meditation and comas", "Awakening and cards", "Transcendence (beyond Illuminated)", "Trial of the Altar (combat, single site)", "Altar focus building (Tier II)", "Way of the Anima (pacifist, multi-site)", "Enlightened enemy psycasters"), building-choice labels, "Bonus psycast XP", "Bonuses and perks", "psyfocus and heat", "psychic sensitivity" mid-sentence, ancient anima tree, ManualReport/SkillReport lines. KEEP capitalized: proper nouns/mechanics — tier names (Awakened/Enlightened/Illuminated/Transcendent), Enlightenment, Awakening, Tier I/II/III, path/spec names, Trial of the Altar, Way of the Anima, Ancient Psycaster Order, Apotheosis, Dignified (focus type), quoted VPE button "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" (matches VPE's actual label — Patch_AutoStatsPerLevel string-matches "Psycaster Stats", do NOT change), Mech-Mind.

## Unchanged
Brain hediffs; Apotheosis/Convergence/Illuminated/Singularity naming; dev tools (incl. Reset to non-psycaster); skills/synergies/specs/pilgrimages/ascensions.
